ios_findings: KnowledgeBookDTO omits shelfCoverUrl and illustrationUrls; KnowledgeBookBodyDTO omits readerCoverUrl and illustrationUrls.
Subscription cover fetch is gated on coverAvailable, absent in publication projection; alternate book cover and detail cover use decorative IllustratedBookCover.
Reader renders markdown but never consumes illustration_urls; all 20 bodies contain zero inline images.
Private media GET requires authentication; generic AsyncImage is insufficient.
limits: Current server c030b9c contains unchanged publication runtime code from pinned local runtime 7414b4e; the two Git SHAs differ.
Specified real-book iOS debug UI and five images verified; Build 67 archived by coordinated task but TestFlight upload remains incomplete.
Nine legacy publications have incomplete media and were not silently overwritten or backfilled.
Isolated ASGI readback validates real data and media hashes, not production login; authentication and real-device evidence are recorded separately.
Story13 complete automatic publication and reader five-media readback passed; toolkit revision2 prepare requires the tested 64-character receipt repair to be deployed.
validation: Inventory counts, all57 media bytes, bodies,401 boundary, historical cutoff, schema fields, retry limit, local Markdown links and git diff --check passed.

pre_fix_automatic_evidence.scope: pre-fix normal Story 08:00; not proof of this new release

dispatch_correlation.inference: builtin controller execution brackets exact-material asset claim; direct asset execution begins during dispatch; direct is native CLI dispatch, not by itself proof of manual user action

author_selector_readback.evidence: Existing server operator status read via configured SSH transport; existing local native handoffs and real recovery claims; worktree author_input implementation. No cron, sessions, drafts or claims mutated.

simulation_only.method: Temporarily patch Claims.exhausted in this Python process to remove only the exact specified exhausted key; no database writes.

media_fix_delivery.device_ui: Passed for publication-234c61fdd8aacdf10057f6d6c6434fc8: real-device XCTest plus independent live-mirror visual inspection; old lock-screen captures excluded. Not TestFlight delivery or historical missing-image repair.

passed_assertions: actual target book ID and existing subscription
two covers plus three illustrations loaded
physical_ui_check.visual_result: Live iPhone Mirroring window inspected: real shelf cover, reader cover, and all three distinct illustrations fully visible; native XCTest screenshots excluded because they capture mirror lock screen
physical_ui_check.scope: Existing authenticated user, preserved subscription, b07 debug client; not a claim that historical 9 books have images or TestFlight includes this fix

asset_launch_findings.second_exit: agent added skip-git but inherited read-only sandbox, no images generated
asset_launch_findings.wait_defect: kill -0 sees zombie PID5854 as live; terminal wait timeout600 started11:13:10; awaiting automatic timeout
asset_launch_findings.repair: existing assets prompt fixes workspace-write/skip-git and original process-handle wait; no new wrapper or bypass

builder_failure.cause: _native_rejected_revision validates retired 00:01 historical bundle against current configured slots

toolkit_generated_images.manifest_hash_state: final after asset session completed at 11:30:13

story_generation_launch.process_manage_discrepancy: reported exited with null exit code while subsequent ps showed active
story_generation_launch.image_completion: pending independent tool and file verification

gaps.acceptance_criterion: 使用指定 Python 3.12 复跑时，任一 kind 缺少合同声明的必填字段均以非零退出码和明确错误拒绝；原正例继续通过，既有三个负例继续拒绝，正文、脚本哈希与执行记录同步更新。
gaps.question: 当前校验器是否真的逐项强制 claim 合同声明的七个字段齐全？
gaps.required_evidence: 修订校验器，显式检查每个 claim 的键集合或逐项必填字段；增加至少一个仅省略 basis_claim_ids、next_check 等字段的冻结负例，并保存 Python 3.12 的真实失败输出与退出码。
gaps.why_reader_needs_it: 读者会把 RESULT=PASS 当作已满足教程定义的本地合同；若必填字段可直接省略，正文的核心验收边界和可复制结论会被高估。

coordinated_deployment.app_build_67: archived by coordinated task, not uploaded to TestFlight

limits: User has not identified actual client/build; iOS source findings do not verify installed application version.
Media success tested against real production data in isolated ASGI process with test principal; real user authentication/UI not tested.

inventory_scope: Original 20-book diagnostic snapshot before media repairs; counts are not the current publication inventory. ios_findings describe pre-fix causes; media_fix_delivery records repairs and real-device validation.

receipt_kind_repair.cause: content producer and local relay accept 64-character kind, shared receipt validator limited it to 40; actual 41-character execution_negative_fixture_missing_fields failed prepare
receipt_kind_repair.change: shared _receipts limit 40 -> 64, preserve frozen content and hashes
receipt_kind_repair.related_regression: 116 passed, 4 existing deprecation warnings; initial sandbox ps denials resolved by identical authorized rerun
